title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (spec.skill.md)
description: patch_file returned error: 'old_string not found in src/moeb/internal/skills/spec.skill.md'. The intended change was recovered by write_file fallback so the operation completed, but the patch_file failure was recorded as a tool error. Likely caused by CRLF line endings in the file not matching the LF string supplied to patch_file.
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file fails with old_string not found on Windows. Confirm the CRLF normalization in patch_file.rs applies consistently to both file content and old_string before substring matching.
